key_observations: HYPOTHESIS FAILED — stability gate failed again (fell_over_rate=0.95 in late window, well past iter 750), despite resetting gait_phase_regularity to -1.0. This disproves the prior diagnosis: gait_phase_regularity=-2.5 was not the root cause of the stability failures. The true destabiliser has not yet been identified.

CV METRICS WORSENED, NOT IMPROVED — gait_air_cv_mean drifted from 0.247→0.299 (baseline→this run), and gait_contact_cv_mean dramatically worsened from 0.334→0.594. The air_time reward increase is not producing the expected periodic stepping cadence; instead the robot is becoming MORE irregular.

AIR_TIME REWARD IS EFFECTIVELY INERT — air_time reward term value=0.0009 (near zero), and air_time_mean=0.032s sits below the 0.05s threshold required to earn the reward. The policy never enters the rewarded window, so the weight increase from 0.2→0.5 has no functional effect on learning. The expected Rule 6 side-effect check (track_linear_velocity dip) is therefore uninformative.

LOCOMOTION SPEED COLLAPSED — locomotion_speed_mean=0.078 m/s is extremely low. The robot is essentially stationary/shuffling, which is consistent with the zero air-time: it is not stepping, it is weight-shifting or barely dragging feet. This may be the proximate cause of both the high fell_over and worsening CV.

POSE_STD_WALKING_SHOULDER_PITCH=0.35 IS THE REMAINING SUSPECT — gait_phase_regularity is now at baseline (-1.0), and air_time weight is producing no signal. The only non-baseline parameter that has persisted across all three failed runs is shoulder_pitch std=0.35. This widened prior on shoulder pitch may be allowing the policy to adopt postures that compromise lateral balance without being penalised by the pose reward.

LANDING FORCE AND SLIP LOOK HEALTHY — landing_force_mean=41.1 N is solidly in the 30–90 N healthy range (Rule 8), and slip_velocity_mean=0.016 is much reduced from the early 0.082 value. These positive signals are irrelevant while stability is failing, but confirm the regime is not wildly wrong.

ENTROPY AND ACTION_STD ARE ACCEPTABLE — entropy declined ~40% from 28.3→17.1 (not a sharp collapse), and action_std=0.57 is well above the over-determinism threshold of 0.1 (Rule 3/4). Exploration is not the problem.

SYMMETRY PATTERN IS MILD MIRROR-POSE LIMP — symmetry_pos_cost_mean=0.030 (low) but symmetry_vel_cost_mean=0.068 (higher), consistent with Rule 9 diagnostic. Not the primary concern while stability is unresolved, but worth watching.
next_suggestion: Full baseline recovery run: reset ALL three changed parameters to confirmed baseline values — gait_phase_regularity_reward_weight=-1.0 (already done), air_time_reward_weight=0.2 (back to baseline), and pose_std_walking_shoulder_pitch back to its original baseline value. This is now the only logical move after three consecutive stability failures: we have not had a stable run to compare against, so we cannot attribute blame to any single change. Once a stable baseline is confirmed (fell_over_rate < 0.5 in late window), reintroduce exactly ONE change at a time — starting with the lowest-risk candidate (air_time_reward_weight, since its functional effect was zero at 0.5, suggesting a more modest increment to 0.3 or 0.35 may be safe). Do NOT reintroduce pose_std changes and air_time changes simultaneously. Per Rule 12, count this recovery run as an experiment — its result is the reference point all future changes are measured against.
